title: crm.product.sale-products-activated, payload v1
description: The outcome of activation (ADR-018 §5). Destination: crm.product.evt.sale-products-activated.v1. A SUCCEEDED outcome is what completes the saga; a FAILED one is the hard case — involvement rows already exist, so the orchestrator compensates the involvement FIRST and only then the products.

failureMessageKey.description: MSG-PROD-NOT-FOUND if an id vanished; otherwise the generic terminal key. Never an exception message (ADR-018 §8).

totalAmount.description: Unused by this step; part of product-service's shared outcome shape.

productIds.description: SUCCEEDED only: the ids that are now ACTV (including any that already were — activation is idempotent).
